notes.title: Patch Note Version 1.10
notes.notes:
Patch note.
 
1, Wall Glitch Fixes  Fixed several collision glitches but maybe you will encounter maybe some of them, 

2, I have tried my best to make Atmosphere Enhancements  to the game atmosphere, so it feels like you are not alone.

3, Script Updates: Implemented and optimized scripts to ensure scanline features are up and running smoothly within the game.

4, General Bug Fixes: Addressed and resolved various minor bugs and issues reported by players to improve game stability and performance.

notes.title: New Update Coming Soon for backroom,
notes.notes:
Today, I decided to work on an update for Backroom, as I want to enhance the overall gameplay experience

This is the update I'm going to work on:

1. Fixing the Walls from Glitching: One of the most common issues reported by players is the walls glitching. I plan to address this by reworking the wall collision detection and rendering processes to ensure smoother gameplay.

2. Improving the Graphics: To make the game more immersive, I will be enhancing the graphics. This includes refining textures and lighting to create a more atmospheric and engaging environment. My goal is to make the visual experience more compelling and eerie, fitting the theme of the game.


3. New Creepy Visual Effect: To intensify the horror experience, I will be introducing a new visual effect called Scanline effect will make the player feel being watched or followed, 

I am excited about these changes and I can't wait to see how you guys react. Stay tuned for more updates

Best Regards
Jacob Jufeili
Lemioutgames

notes.title: Time to release the game
notes.notes: I've been thinking about releasing this game earlier since I might not have the time later on. Today seems like the day to do it because I'm moving to a different city where I won't have internet access for 3 to 4 weeks. During this time, I plan to focus more on game development without internet, relying on my own imagination and efforts to work on my big project called 'Forgotten Bunker 1939.' There's a lot of work that needs to be done, so maybe in 3 to 4 weeks, I might have a finished game. I'm not sure exactly when it will be released, but it will eventually be available on Steam
